name: TP-Link router
author: NetMaster
description: Reads the system log, connected clients and live traffic from a TP-Link router (Archer and Deco models supported by tplinkrouterc6u). Adds a security check of the router's settings and lets you pause a device's internet. Never logs you out: if you are logged in to the router's web page, it waits.

settings.label: Router IP address
settings.help: Leave empty to use the main router.

settings.label: Password
settings.help: The password for the router's web page.
